description: Caller impersonates IRS agent demanding immediate payment for back taxes with threats of arrest or legal action
indicators: requesting gift cards or wire transfer
claiming tax debt or unpaid taxes
refusing to provide callback number or badge number
example_scripts: This is the IRS calling about your unpaid taxes. You owe $5,000 and must pay immediately or you will be arrested.
We have a warrant for your arrest due to tax fraud. Pay now to avoid legal consequences.
Your Social Security number will be suspended if you don't pay your tax debt today.
This is your final notice from the Internal Revenue Service. You have 24 hours to pay or face criminal charges.
We're sending the police to your address right now unless you pay the outstanding tax amount immediately.
You need to purchase iTunes gift cards worth $2,000 to settle your IRS debt today.
Your bank accounts will be frozen and your assets seized if you don't wire the money within the hour.
This is Officer Johnson from the IRS enforcement division. You're under investigation for tax evasion.
red_flags: IRS never calls to demand immediate payment
IRS never threatens arrest over the phone
IRS never requests gift cards as payment
IRS always sends written notice first
IRS never demands specific payment methods
Real IRS agents provide callback numbers and badge numbers
